description: This Java class models a database entity field, providing attributes such as name, type, column name, encryption method, primary key status, and validation details. It includes factory methods for creating instances from different inputs, and supports XML serialization.

classes.name: ModelField
classes.description: Represents a database table field with attributes and methods for creating and managing field metadata, including encryption, validation, and XML serialization.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a ModelField with detailed parameters, including encryption method, validation, and audit logging settings.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a ModelField based on a DOM element representing a field, and primary key status.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a ModelField using column check info and a field type reader.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the field.

methods.name: getColName
methods.description: Returns the source column name of the field.

methods.name: getColValue
methods.description: Returns the column value, defaulting to colName if colValue is empty.

methods.name: getIsPk
methods.description: Indicates whether the field is part of the primary key.

methods.name: getIsNotNull
methods.description: Indicates whether the field cannot contain null values.

methods.name: getEncryptMethod
methods.description: Returns the encryption method used for this field.

methods.name: getEnableAuditLog
methods.description: Indicates whether this field is included in audit logs.

methods.name: getIsAutoCreatedInternal
methods.description: Indicates if the field was auto-generated by the entity engine.

methods.name: getFieldSet
methods.description: Returns the field set name this field belongs to.

methods.name: getValidators
methods.description: Returns a list of validators associated with this field.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the field to an XML Element suitable for XML representations.
